# Death and abandon fixtures

`run7-snap-3.json` and `run7-snap-4.json` are compact extracts from captured in-game save states after Bonel died during a Courtyard raid and after the party returned through the in-game retreat dialog, respectively. The original fixture filenames are retained for existing test imports. Bonel (58) and Brereton (96) retain their full raw hero records. Other roster records retain the captured status, before-town status, building, class, actor and trinket data, preserving the real 28 living/29 total count. Upgrade extracts retain GUID 58 purchases and the Stage Coach roster-size purchases. The active-raid fixture also includes the active `plot_crimson_court_2` raid and estate. The source captures remain read-only.

`roster-capacity-rules.json` extracts `roster_size_upgrades` from the installed base and Radiant Stage Coach building JSON files and the `additional.roster_size` bonus from Shieldbreaker's roster additional-variables JSON. Base/New Game+/Bloodmoon use 9/12/16/20/24/28, Radiant uses 9/12/16/21/25/30, and Shieldbreaker adds one. Runtime code reads the installed files; the fixture supplies deterministic tests.

These fixtures check JSON mutations, safety guards and Discard behavior. Town revival and the Courtyard minimal abandon were also verified in game on 2026-10-20; regular-raid, trinket and loot cases remain unverified (see checklist scenarios 11 and 12).
